title: Great Application.
body: Great app. I loved everything about it, especially the fact that you are building something. However, it’s a shame that it lasts only 60 days. It would have been so much more enjoyable if I could have build something infinitely (or at least more than 60 days). I love the sense of path and fulfillment it brings.
author: Awequ

title: Clean addictive UI
body:
Just hit 62 days in a row of my morning routine. It wouldn’t be possible without this app and it’s widgets. I feel good when i see that on the widget, all 7 days are completed. 
But, i really would appreciate if you add some color customisation to widgets. All the themes that are available in app, sometimes apply wierd colors to widgets that do not fit with any of my iphone themes or wallpapers. So I would like to choose widget colors separately at least from default ones (e.g. black, blue, white, red etc.)
author: Fuc u anjom ama

title: UX is on the low level
body: 1. I see “add new habit” tap on it and nothing is happening. 2. I don't understand why I can't delete an active habit. 3. I have no opportunity to set my own days count for a habit.
author: valSyn

title: Beautiful
body: Minimalistic, highly satisfying and actually works! you can be on track everyday because you like to visit this app
author: ✌🏻️Christine
